blocked.reason: no legitimate benign glasses/makeup/low-light population exists here. SiW-Mv2's Makeup_* and Partial_*Glasses videos are labelled SPOOF presentations, so treating them as benign live stress cases would invert their label; CASIA-FASD and MSU-MFSD carry no benign attribute metadata. Recorded as blocked rather than substituted with an invalid population.

tests.failure_meaning: a generator fingerprint the detector could shortcut on
tests.measures: balanced accuracy of a probe trained to separate synthetic from real spoof
tests.pass_rule: probe balanced accuracy stays below the declared ceiling
tests.population: source_train real spoof vs accepted M8 v3 synthetic spoof; no target

tests.failure_meaning: the detector reads compression artefacts as attack evidence
tests.measures: shift of the spoof score on unchanged bona-fide content
tests.pass_rule: no systematic large increase in the spoof score
tests.population: source_dev LIVE only, benign JPEG re-encode; no spoof, no target

tests.failure_meaning: the detector reads resampling as attack evidence
tests.measures: shift of the spoof score on unchanged bona-fide content
tests.pass_rule: no systematic large increase in the spoof score
tests.population: source_dev LIVE only, benign resize; no spoof, no target

tests.failure_meaning: the detector reads colour statistics as attack evidence
tests.measures: shift of the spoof score on unchanged bona-fide content
tests.pass_rule: no systematic large increase in the spoof score
tests.population: source_dev LIVE only, benign colour shift; no spoof, no target

tests.failure_meaning: the score does not depend on the artefact it claims to detect
tests.measures: spoof score and regional distance at zero residual
tests.pass_rule: score approaches live and the regional distance falls
tests.population: source_train live with the GPAT residual scaled to 0; no target

tests.failure_meaning: the regional evidence is not localized where the attack is
tests.measures: displacement of the anomaly heat-map peak
tests.pass_rule: the heat-map moves with the attacked region
tests.population: source_train live under two recipes differing only in region; no target

tests.failure_meaning: the local head ignores the supervision it is given
tests.measures: local supervision performance under a mismatched artefact map
tests.population: accepted M8 v3 synthetic samples with artefact maps swapped; no target

tests.failure_meaning: a preprocessing shortcut rather than a physical cue
tests.measures: score sensitivity to a preprocessing-only change
tests.population: source_dev under a different crop padding/interpolation; no target

tests.failure_meaning: the detector learned one generator, not the artefact class
tests.measures: cross-route generalization of the synthetic evidence
tests.population: train on one synthetic route, evaluate on the other; source only
